_comment: Japanese-band-only mode. RSS sources: Spincoaster (indie/R&B/hip-hop), ROCKIN'ON JAPAN news (broader rock/live-house scene), BARKS (broad, but only returns ~10 latest items so its net contribution is small/inconsistent). All share a compatible “…”/「…」-for-songs, 『』-for-albums convention. Gekirock was tried and removed: it structurally covers Western rock/metal (Tom Morello, MGK, FROM FIRST TO LAST, etc.) using the exact same release-announcement phrasing as Japanese acts, so it kept leaking foreign artists past every filter for very little genuine Japanese-scene content in return — not worth the ongoing excludeArtists maintenance. Plus a non-RSS source: eggs.mu's daily song ranking (scripts/lib/eggs.js, config below under 'eggs') — a Japan-only unsigned/indie artist distribution platform, so every entry is trustworthy as indie/newcomer without needing the nationality or newcomer-keyword heuristics. excludeKeywords is a best-effort nationality filter for the RSS sources (see README) — it only catches a foreign act when the headline itself mentions a country/city. fetch_songs.js also cross-checks the resolved YouTube channel's declared country (when set) as a second, independent nationality signal. excludeArtists is a manual safety net for major-label/veteran/idol/international acts that slip past both of those (either because they still match the release-announcement format, the channel didn't declare a country, or the YouTube search fallback attached the wrong channel's stats).
